criteria.intent: Make the existing Writing world formula crisp while retaining its expression, ribbon palette, perspective, tilt, pulse and camera motion.
criteria.automated_scope: Actual Canvas submissions share world haze alpha and high-quality sampling, restore sampling state, and retain one 1380x240 cache and 24 bounded submissions. World-plane separation stays below half the projected glyph stroke at narrow/medium/desktop widths and two camera positions. Existing producer checks verify finite canonical artwork, one Writing-only world landmark, matching static layer alpha and immutable packaged identity. Perceived sharpness remains visual acceptance.

criteria.intent: Widen the painted reading protection around large headings across pages, keeping text and native layout intact.
criteria.automated_scope: Reuse maintained Day/Night foreground contrast and no-blur/no-independent-animation checks, plus the single-authority contract for site/engine/reading-surfaces.css. Generated public CSS must concatenate the exact authored sources; ordinary base CSS and Color styles cannot add a second reading-paint authority. Shared reading paint uses theme paper at 87% background alpha (13% transparency), retaining full text/control opacity and the same-owner 100% reduced-transparency preference, crisp edges without masks/blur/feather and a 12px effective outer radius, including title radius plus its zero-blur paint spread. The owner does not introduce flow padding/margin/font changes; meaningful duplicate per-route/Color override mutations fail. Actual native geometry, computed cascade across the thirteen representative surfaces including Appearance and visual uniformity remain explicit browser/human evidence.

criteria.intent: Preserve responsive rendering, navigation, Off/reduced-motion freezing, graceful static fallback and bounded formula resources.
criteria.automated_scope: Reuse the actual formula cache/failure/viewport/room cases and canonical live/static producer checks, plus existing Off/reduced/hidden/print freeze and route-mount cases. The same cache survives visits and frozen states, work stops while frozen, renderer failure is contained and no second navigation animation clock appears. Fixtures do not supply current-source browser/device observations.

criteria.intent: Deliver canonical generated output and a reviewable owning-issue/Draft-PR change with exact checks and honest acceptance state.
criteria.automated_scope: Current RI inventory/views and actual CI coupling, explicit owning-issue selection and pending human-gate semantics. Existing Basic and hosted preview CI remain separately required; this policy does not duplicate them, ingest their artifacts, grant independent review or authorize merge.

criteria.intent: Keep the first fresh-session Home to Research flight, subsequent adjacent forward flights and reverse Talks to Writing to Research to Home flights in one continuous ribbon world, without start, midpoint-mount or arrival resets.
criteria.automated_scope: Maintained fixed-world-cell projection checks compare shared ribbon station IDs and projected contours across fractional adaptive tiers and forward/reverse route poses at narrow and desktop widths. Existing material checks retain world-anchored colors across mesh windows and near-plane clipping; periodic geometry/velocity checks retain the 24-second phase. The actual midflight DOM/layout camera fixture is shared with AC06. Fixtures establish mathematical and lifecycle invariants, not absence of a visible frame step in a browser.

criteria.intent: Keep midflight layout and target changes and quick retargeting continuous from the displayed camera and shared ambient state; adaptive detail preserves existing ribbon samples and lifecycle/resource bounds.
criteria.automated_scope: Maintained runtime/navigation fixtures forward native top, bottom, history and fragment landing intent before the first flight paint. Known reverse endpoints plan the actual destination bottom with cold and prepared rooms, departing source-DOM events cannot retarget the destination, and unresolved history/fragment landings hold the displayed camera until destination mount. Actual sampled camera depth stays between departure and destination without mount reversal; layout and resize retargets preserve the displayed camera and shared clock. Existing cases retain settled/adaptive flight detail, bounded multi-room preparation, stale-navigation cancellation, detail freezing, quality recovery and draw-failure completion. The maintained reading-clarity validator negative rejects wrong landing targets, overshoot and depth reversal. Shared ribbon, freeze and formula-cache/failure checks run once per unique selected check. Scoped hosted smoke, independent review and current-source visual acceptance remain separate evidence.

G01.description: Inspect exact-current-source paired Writing formula captures in Day/Night at narrow and desktop sizes against the original screenshot complaint: sharp connected contours, readable expression, coherent depth/tilt/pulse and no displaced pale copies. Maintainer visual acceptance remains explicit.

G02.description: Review the matching opt-in reading-clarity report and paired captures: all 60 route/width/theme/zoom geometry cases pass with source/CSS identities retained, equal heading and glyph Range geometry, equal scroll widths, no overflow and positive uniform reading margins for every visible heading at least 25px. Also inspect actual computed reading paint for thirteen representative surfaces including the Appearance popup across all five pages in Day/Night at desktop and narrow widths: theme-paper color at 87% background alpha, element opacity one (text/controls stay opaque), the same-owner reduced-transparency override at 100%, no mask/blur/feather and a common 12px effective radius at all four outer corners. For inline titles compare border radius plus zero-blur paint spread, not the inner border radius alone. Inspect the baseline/candidate captures, consistent block isolation and both lines of the marked Talks title; expanded backgrounds must never cover adjacent-line glyph bottoms. CSS zoom/Chromium evidence does not supply physical Safari/iPad acceptance. Current-source maintainer visual acceptance remains explicit.

G03.description: Matching raw-head preview smoke and scoped browser evidence preserve room isolation, narrow/desktop/200% CSS-zoom readability, forward/back/filter behavior, one formula, stopped work in Off/reduced states and coherent no-JS/no-Canvas static fallback. Record current source/public identity and actual observations; native macOS WebKit and physical-device production gates retain their existing owners.

G04.description: Record the exact live issue/PR/Refs commits, same-source required Basic/targeted/navigation/acceptance and opt-in evidence runs, CI-controlled preview artifact and independent review. Reconcile the actual AC checkboxes in the owning issue; local preparation, fixture success or an earlier head do not complete these requirements.

G05.description: Applicable maintainer decision, normal merge of the accepted candidate and exact merged-source reconciliation before closure. Passing checks or publishing a PR preview do not supply merge or production authorization.

G06.description: Inspect a small exact-current-source Color browser sequence with retained frame evidence in Day/Night at desktop and narrow sizes. Begin with a fresh session and first Home to Research flight, continue all adjacent forward flights, then reverse Talks to Writing to Research to Home; repeat with prepared destination rooms. Exercise actual native departure edges and true backward atEnd destination landings, retaining native scroll/range observations and planned endpoint before destination mount. Verify camera depth stays within the actual departure/arrival endpoints, advances in the intended direction without overshoot or reversal at mount, and departing source-DOM scroll/layout cannot change the destination. Verify no geometry/material/phase reset or opacity step at start, midpoint DOM mount or arrival; also inspect quick navigation, unresolved history/fragment landings and layout retargeting from the displayed camera. Record raw-head/public identity, scoped hosted smoke and actual observations; maintainer visual acceptance of this current source remains explicit. Earlier-head approvals, earlier browser reports or fixture success cannot close this gate.
